title: CrewAI Core Framework
summary: This module forms the foundational architecture of CrewAI, orchestrating intelligent agents, managing task workflows, and integrating with various Large Language Models. It provides essential utilities, handles event management, state persistence, and facilitates agent-to-agent communication and tool integration.

nodes.label: Agent & Execution Core
nodes.title: Agent & Execution Core
nodes.description: Defines the core logic for creating, managing, and executing AI agents, including their reasoning, planning, and interaction with tools.

nodes.label: Flow Orchestration & Tasks
nodes.title: Flow Orchestration & Tasks
nodes.description: Manages the definition, execution, and visualization of multi-step agent workflows, handling task dependencies, state, and human feedback.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: LLM Integration
nodes.description: Provides a unified interface for connecting to and interacting with various Large Language Models, abstracting provider-specific details for agents.

nodes.label: Event & State Management
nodes.title: Event & State Management
nodes.description: Implements a robust event bus for system-wide communication, manages execution state, memory, and checkpointing for crew operations.

nodes.label: Core Utilities & Configuration
nodes.title: Core Utilities & Configuration
nodes.description: Offers a collection of foundational helper functions, configuration management, project annotations, security settings, and telemetry for the framework.

nodes.label: Agent-to-Agent Communication
nodes.title: Agent-to-Agent Communication
nodes.description: Enables secure and structured delegation of tasks and information exchange between different AI agents, supporting collaborative workflows.

nodes.label: Tools & RAG System
nodes.title: Tools & RAG System
nodes.description: Manages the definition, adaptation, and usage of external tools by agents, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for knowledge retrieval.

groups.label: Core Components
groups.title: Core CrewAI Components
groups.description: The foundational modules that define and orchestrate the intelligent agents and their workflows within the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: Supporting Infrastructure
groups.title: Supporting Infrastructure
groups.description: Essential modules providing underlying services such as LLM integration, event handling, state management, and general utilities to the core components.

groups.label: External Interactions
groups.title: External Interactions
groups.description: Modules that enable CrewAI to interact with external systems, including other agents (A2A) and various tools or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
